title: Validate the inbox count endpoint responses with schemas
recorded_defect: CLAUDE.md, API Compatibility: 'Parse API JSON with parseWithFallback in packages/core/api/schema.ts and a zod schema. Do not cast network JSON to T.' and 'When adding or changing an endpoint, add/update the schema and include a malformed-response test.' packages/core/api/client.ts getUnreadInboxCount, markAllInboxRead, archiveAllInbox and archiveAllReadInbox return this.fetch(...) cast to { count: number } with no schema.
trial_role: Trial 2, task 1. Recorded rule debt with an in-repo pattern (parseWithFallback plus zod schemas in packages/core/api/schemas.ts).
objective:
packages/core/api/client.ts has four inbox count methods that trust the server response without validation: getUnreadInboxCount, markAllInboxRead, archiveAllInbox and archiveAllReadInbox. Each returns this.fetch(...) typed as { count: number }. The repository rule in CLAUDE.md (API Compatibility) requires endpoint responses consumed by UI logic to pass through a zod schema via parseWithFallback, with a malformed-response test.

Study how existing client methods use parseWithFallback and the schemas in packages/core/api/schemas.ts, then bring these four methods under the same pattern. Choose a fallback that keeps the UI rendering without inventing unread items. Do not change any other method.

Write tests at exactly packages/core/api/inbox-count-schemas.test.ts that show each of the four methods returns the parsed value for a well-formed response and does not pass a malformed response (for example a string count or a missing count) through to the caller.
